content.comment_body: Hello, I have a page created using [product_name], but I'd like to make it more dynamic and responsive. Is there any method or documentation I can follow to customize the page further? Is it possible to build it from scratch using HTML5, since I noticed the files are in HTM and XHTML formats?
Are you already familiar with HTML5? Do you know about the [product_name] manual? It doesn't provide much detail, but it's a starting point for modifying pages with HTML5.
Thank you. Are you referring to this manual? I'll take a look at it.
Yes, I was referring to the Online Help. Unfortunately, [company_name] no longer offers an operating manual like they did for the first [product_name] version.

I've tried using several HTML commands, such as <meta name="viewport" content="width=500, initial-scale=1" />, to make a page responsive in [product_name], but I haven't been successful. I suspect that settings within the editor could be overriding these HTML modifications. Has anyone else faced this problem or found a workaround to achieve responsive design here? Any tips or examples would be welcome. Thanks!

Hi, I’ve also been experimenting with ways to make the web interface responsive using frameworks like w3.css. During project development, [product_name] generates two key files—one sets up an environment that calls the other. It would be great if responsiveness could be added, improving usability for different users. Currently, [product_name] limits options to just one set display. If you discover a solution, I’d appreciate it if you could share your findings. Regards.

analysis.insight_summary: Users working with [product_name] face notable restrictions when trying to design dynamic, responsive web pages. Attempts to apply familiar HTML5 techniques and external CSS frameworks are hindered by the editor's limitations. Available documentation and support are minimal, causing users to rely on trial and error and exchange questions within forums.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to customize and improve web pages to be responsive across various devices using standard web development methods and clear, detailed documentation.
